title: Conditional additive boundary-error Cauchy criterion
purpose: Record a Lean-checked bridge that keeps the R-484 boundary defect as an explicit additive error budget. If a source-owned bulk bound and a source-owned boundary bound both tend to zero in the already-declared order, every real cylinder sequence satisfying the pairwise bound is Cauchy and convergent. The packet does not supply either bound or define a full-Q Gibbs state.

lean.scope: Real-valued cylinder sequences with explicit additive bulk and boundary error budgets in a fixed ordered limit. The boundary is retained as a separate term; a persistent positive floor is formally excluded from convergence to zero.

boundary_contract.r484_defect: At the all-zero square-to-split boundary, the exact hidden defect is 16/9.
boundary_contract.treatment: The defect is not averaged, cancelled, or replaced by a counterterm. A future source-owned estimate must provide a nonnegative boundary_error(n) and prove its convergence to zero in the declared order.
boundary_contract.failure_if_persistent: R498 proves that an eventually persistent positive boundary budget cannot tend to zero. If the source-owned boundary budget has such a floor, the zero-error Cauchy route is blocked and the full-Q question remains HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
boundary_contract.csw: R-490 C_sw=540 remains domination-only and is not a probability weight or an intertwining identity.

assumptions: s, bulk, and boundary are real-valued sequences indexed by the already-fixed ordered limit.
bulk tends to zero and boundary tends to zero along the same ordered limit.
The error budgets are kept additive; when nonnegativity is needed it is supplied explicitly for each sequence.
For eventual separation, a finite N is supplied after which the boundary budget is exactly zero.
theorem_contract.conclusion: The explicit additive bound yields a Cauchy sequence and therefore a unique real limit; an eventually zero boundary is accepted only through the same bound.
not_supplied: No source-owned w_(n,R,Q) law or projective cross-Q kernel.
No definition of mu_(n,R), omega, common cylinder probability space, or PAH-specific bulk_error/boundary_error formulas.
No proof that the R-484 16/9 defect decays in the declared n and R_max order.
No R-488 nonzero estimate or stationarity passage.

non_claims: This packet does not instantiate PAH sector weights, a full-Q Gibbs measure, a common positive normalized cylinder state, or a PAH-specific Cauchy estimate.
It does not prove projective consistency, R-488 nonzero, stationarity, Gibbs-L2 convergence, closability, an infinite-volume semigroup, or an ordered thermodynamic limit.
It does not prove that the R-484 boundary defect vanishes; persistent boundary error remains an explicit obstruction to this bridge.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmological, or TOE conclusion follows.
